description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of mentions across various news sources. The chart contains 16 slices, each representing a different news outlet or a combined “Other” category. The slices are labeled as follows: “Breitbart” (blue, 14%), “Other” (grey, 13%), “The Guardian” (purple, 5%), “BBC” (orange, 4%), “RT” (dark blue, 3%), “Daily Kos” (green, 3%), “National Review” (red, 3%), “Daily RedState” (yellow, 3%), “Fox News” (brown, 3%), “CNN” (pink, 3%), “Shareblue” (light brown, 3%), “PoliticusUSA” (dark purple, 3%), “The Huffington Post” (green, 6%), “NPR” (light purple, 6%), “Vox” (dark green, 6%), and “Drudge Report” (teal, 7%). Percentage labels are included within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered roughly in descending order by percentage, with the largest slices positioned towards the top of the chart and smaller slices arranged around the bottom. A legend is not present.
